answer_1.quote: We greatly expand the coverage of languages to 101, far beyond the current coverage of open-source massively multilingual models.

answer_2.quote: On FLORES-200 where 93 language-pairs (English ↔ X) are included, Aya (translation-heavy) shows the highest improvement over mT0x with an average spBLUE score of 44% and 31% for X → English and English → X respectively.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 as LLM evaluator to pick the preferred model generation on the Aya eval suite similar to human evaluation.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we ask compensated professional annotators for Serbian, Russian, Hindi, French, Arabic, Spanish, English to choose their preferred model completions using the Aya Evaluation Suite introduced in for open-ended generations.
